# Golden replay fixtures

Frames CSVs in the PoC export format (`t,ratio,globalRatio,global,state`). `src/engine/replay.test.ts` replays every `**/*.csv` here through the detector (default settings) and the lap logic, and snapshots the passes and lap list. Add the expected pass count for each file to `EXPECTED` in that test.

| File | Scenario | Expected passes |
|---|---|---|
| `synthetic/laps-30fps.csv` | Generated by `scripts/make-synthetic-csv.ts`: 36 s at 30 fps, a dark blob crossing at 2.0, 7.3, 7.9 (inside the cooldown → SUPPRESSED), 12.45, 17.02, 28.0 and 33.1 s; a 4 s hand wave from 20 s (→ REJECTED); lights flash at 25.5 s (global frames) | 6 (5 laps) |
| `field/*.csv` | M0 recordings (plan 0.4), each with a short scenario note here | per scenario |
